backbone: 12 3x3 convs,4 residual blocks,GroupNorm retained,independent Kaiming initialization; no widening copy
parameter_budget_axis: Capacity experiments separate from equal-backbone feature-calibration ablation

phase1.loss: CE(.05 smoothing)+.5 normalized two-view mean/variance alignment

phase2.loss: CE(.05 smoothing)+.5 alignment+.25 5-way cosine episode CE, alternate1/5shot

augmentation: Independent per-image crop/flip/color; second view is same augmented image horizontal flip, identical across controls for fixed seed.
downstream: Base-train mean/variance calibration+prototype adaptation retained; graph optional, selected on val only
selection: Fixed val tasks, epoch0 eligible at each new branch; evaluate full val paired confirmation before one frozen test; repeated public test exposure disclosed.
report: Three training seed variation separately from600-episode CI; add params,model bytes,CPU latency,memory; preserve Baseline/exact2nd-order MAML/calibration comparisons.
device: No GPU training until Code43 is resolved and isolated CUDA environment passes smoke; GPU training does not require GPU deployment.
